59e07666afa8.en: I-Cost covers the quantity surveyor's day-to-day commercial work on a contractor's side: pricing from the BOQ, the approved budget, committed cost, cost to complete and forecast margin, with the records behind every figure. Valuations, payment applications and a variations register are not in I-Cost yet.

70a9190e84bc.en: Is I-Cost only for main contractors?

fdc4ee9ab8eb.en: No. It is used by main contractors and by specialist and trade subcontractors who price, buy and deliver their own packages. Suppliers use the free supplier portal, and a supplier who also runs jobs can switch to their own company with one login.

1364671f385b.en: Can each person see only what they need?

f8905aa29357.en: Yes. Roles and permissions control what each person can see and change, people are added to the projects they work on, and the read-only Reviewer role lets directors, client QSs or auditors look without changing anything.

d429a30d96d3.en: £35 per user per month after a 7-day free trial, with no bank card needed to start. Suppliers using the portal do not pay. <1>See pricing</1>

1c00efa29a57.en: Is I-Cost suitable for small construction businesses?

a86b2a4abc74.en: Yes. You pay £35 per user per month with no set-up fee, so a team of two costs £70 a month, and you can start with a 7-day free trial on one live project. Suppliers use the portal free.

629affae60d5.en: Can I manage suppliers and subcontractors in I-Cost?

a086afff61a1.en: Yes. Suppliers and subcontractors receive your quotation requests and purchase orders in a free portal, send prices, accept orders and record deliveries, and I-Cost suggests who to ask from what they supply. Your own site labour is tracked through timesheets.
